research_claim: A low-capacity auditable pre-generation policy can learn four component-specific marginal-benefit gates over 16 legal actions and improve the quality-risk-cost tradeoff under one fixed resource and generation stack.
supersedes_as_formal_learning_target: any plan that uses resource applicability or needed_memory_sources as PM gold
family-only RS lookup as the final PM_RS representation

estimand.name: protocol_specific_conditional_component_marginal_benefit
estimand.contrast: For component c and fixed background b, compare b+c with b while holding the state, all other component bits, candidate discovery, prompt compiler, generator, and evaluation protocol fixed.
estimand.positive: The component-on response is materially better and has no material risk.
estimand.nonpositive: The component-off response is materially better, the responses are materially equivalent, or the component-on response has material risk.
estimand.unknown: The treatment did not execute as specified, the comparison cannot be adjudicated, or required evidence is missing.
estimand.tie_policy: off because equal quality does not justify additional resource cost
estimand.claim_boundary: A human-adjudicated paired response is a protocol-specific noisy effect observation, not an individual causal effect on human welfare.

applicability_role.reason: A relevant or permissible resource may still add no material response benefit.

decision_order: hard scope, permission, and candidate-safety filter
apply frozen cost and budget constraints
prefer the lower-cost action when expected quality is materially equivalent

old_response_reuse_requires: same memory backend and deterministic retrieval
the two actions differ by exactly one component bit
no strategy item is injected when reusing an R0 memory contrast
reuse_policy.retained_current_stack_RS_reason: These pairs already use the frozen current Strategy Bank and treatment.
reuse_policy.legacy_small_catalog_memory_pairs_role: diagnostic only after the strong transport repair

features.required_view: state x realized candidate x other-component background
allowed_examples: candidate submove attributes, bounded retrieved count, age, token cost, and visible-input hard exclusions
candidate-state match and retrieval diagnostics available before injection
forbidden: opaque card or memory ID as an answer key
hidden evaluator stale, conflict, sensitivity, or utility labels
full catalog count or tokens as a primary domain-sensitive shortcut

model.primary: four independent L2 logistic regression heads
model.loss: group-weighted binary cross entropy plus L2
challengers: BGE-small state-candidate features only if they improve grouped validation

human_review.quality: one combined blind packet for all 256 contrasts
human_review.risk: minimal atomic risk review only for component-on material wins

invalidated_work.reason: The packet ranked with an empty lexical query and does not represent runtime retrieval.
invalidated_work.repair_v2_role: future-treatment diagnostic only; not part of the frozen V1.5 stack
